# State Nationalist Reform

> Public website for State Nationalist Reform, organized into five separate, indexable pages on https://statenationalistreform.com/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://statenationalistreform.com/): Strategic briefing and navigation to the site's main sections.
- [Mission](https://statenationalistreform.com/mission.html): Mission and strategic initiatives.
- [Funding and Trust](https://statenationalistreform.com/funding-trust.html): Funding materials and asset-distribution visualization.
- [Standing](https://statenationalistreform.com/standing.html): Standing information and jurisdictional-flow visualization.
- [Vault](https://statenationalistreform.com/vault.html): Vault resource listings and optional direct USDC transfer on Base.

## Payment behavior

- The Vault displays an optional direct transfer of USDC on Base.
- No fixed amount is listed, and payment is not required to browse.
- The website does not verify transfers or unlock content based on payment.
- x402 is not enabled; the transfer card is not a checkout or paywall.
